description: Full product record for one package NDC: normalized NDC forms; RxNav status, RxCUI, concept name and history; labeler, marketing category, status and dates, application number, DEA schedule, imprint, color, shape and size from RxNav; brand and generic name, dosage form, route, active ingredients with strengths and package description from the openFDA NDC Directory; latest CMS NADAC unit cost; openFDA recall enforcement reports from the last 36 months. Price: $0.02 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.
